newsitem.title: USA: Salomon seen as takeover target - report.
newsitem.headline: Salomon seen as takeover target - report.

text.p: Salomon Inc is now seen as a takeover target and an unnamed U.S. commercial bank and an unnamed Swiss bank are seen as likely suitors, according to Business Week's Inside Wall Street column.
Salomon "has been elevated to the top of the list of buyout targets," a New York investment banker, who claims to know about an expression of interest by a U.S. commercial bank, told the magazine.
An investment strategist in New York told the magazine about a Swiss bank that has "informally communicated" its interest to Salomon executives.
The magazine also reported that investment guru and 18.5 percent shareholder Warren Buffet is inclined now toward a sale.

The investment banker who claims to be aware of the U.S. bank's interest told the magazine that Salomon's executives are looking for a $135 a share price, but the bank appears to be looking at a $90 a share price -- or two times book value.
Salomon and Buffett could not be reached for comment.
